lines.speaker: tessaly_veil
lines.text: You track by instinct. I track by intent. Guess which one wins.

lines.speaker: lyra_ashwalker
lines.text: Instinct. Every time. Intent tells you where you want to go. Instinct tells you what's already there.

lines.speaker: lyra_ashwalker
lines.text: You picked that lock in three seconds flat.

lines.speaker: tessaly_veil
lines.text: You scouts are too attached to the map. The map is a lie someone told about the territory.

lines.speaker: lyra_ashwalker
lines.text: I update mine as I go.

lines.speaker: tessaly_veil
lines.text: I trust everyone to do exactly what they're likely to do. That's not trust, that's arithmetic.

lines.speaker: tessaly_veil
lines.text: You ever just run? No mission, no trail, no one counting on you?

lines.speaker: lyra_ashwalker
lines.text: Once. Felt wrong after a week.
